name: Super-Increasing Recurrence Disguise
description: Replaced the matrix determinant condition (which models easily recognize as a permutation matrix / exact cover) with a mathematically equivalent numerical target sum using a super-increasing recursive sequence H(x) = 23*H(x-1) + 1. Because the multiplier 23 exceeds the maximum possible relay count (k=22), the ONLY way to achieve the target sum T_k is to select exactly one of each channel 1..k. Models relying on pattern matching will attempt a Knapsack/Subset Sum DFS and Time Out due to the massive search space of small elements, while models that understand the structure will deduce the Exact Cover requirement and use Dancing Links or exact-once bitmask backtracking.
